title: Mario-Verse LxF Mix
description: Welcome, This is a Resource pack for WenXin's Marioverse Mod Providing a Game Acurate Look to the Items, Blocks, & Mobs
body:
Welcome, This is a Resourcepack for WenXin's Marioverse Mod (https://modrinth.com/mod/marioverse)



The point of this pack is to server as a more "True to the Games" pack while the base textures are more attune to base Minecraft's style

The pack Only includes Items, Some Blocks, & Sounds for now, with a plan to expand more into making mob textures sooner or later!
